    applyOnEndGame(Player, Game, BuildingCard) - Method in class it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.effects.buildings.BuildingJobAuraBonus
    At the end of the game, credits aura based on characters of the configured job: either by summing their base aura (useCardBaseAura), or by multiplying their number by the building's multiplier.
    applyOnEndGame(Player, Game, BuildingCard) - Method in class it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.effects.buildings.BuildingSixDifferentAura
    At the end of the game, awards 6 aura for each complete set of the six different jobs: the number of sets equals the least represented job in the tribe.
    applyOnEndGame(Player, Game, T) - Method in interface it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.IEffect
     
    applyOnEvent(Player, Game, BuildingCard, EventCard) - Method in class it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.effects.buildings.BuildingEventCostModifier
    Sets temporary modifiers on the player which are then read by the event effect: food discount on Sustenance (for their own job), or extra food/aura on Hunting/Cave Paintings events when the event matches the building type.
    applyOnEvent(Player, Game, BuildingCard, EventCard) - Method in class it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.effects.buildings.BuildingShamanPassive
    Sets temporary shields on the player which are then read by the Shamanic Ritual event: immunity to aura loss and/or doubling of the bonus.
    applyOnEvent(Player, Game, EventCard, EventCard) - Method in class it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.effects.events.EventArtist
    For each player compares the number of artists with the event threshold: below threshold applies the aura penalty, from the threshold up credits artists * multiplier; finally resets temporary modifiers.
    applyOnEvent(Player, Game, EventCard, EventCard) - Method in class it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.effects.events.EventFarmer
    For each player calculates the sustenance cost (1 per card in tribe), subtracts the gatherers discount (×3) and the buildings discount, and applies the cost: if the food is insufficient, converts the missing part into aura loss.
    applyOnEvent(Player, Game, EventCard, EventCard) - Method in class it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.effects.events.EventHunter
    For each player credits food and aura proportional to the number of hunters (plus temporary building bonuses), then resets temporary modifiers.
    applyOnEvent(Player, Game, EventCard, EventCard) - Method in class it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.effects.events.EventShaman
    Calculates the maximum and minimum magic points among the players: the one at the maximum gains the bonus (doubled if they have the "double aura" building and are the only one at the maximum), the one at the minimum suffers the malus (unless "no loss"); then resets the temporary modifiers.
    applyOnEvent(Player, Game, T, EventCard) - Method in interface it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.IEffect

    it.polimi.ingsw.am54 - package it.polimi.ingsw.am54
    Root of the Mesos project (group AM54), a multiplayer board game developed for the Software Engineering Final Project.
    it.polimi.ingsw.am54.controller - package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.controller
    Server-side controller (the "C" in MVC).
    it.polimi.ingsw.am54.database - package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.database
    Persistence of results and leaderboard on a PostgreSQL database (Aiven cloud).
    it.polimi.ingsw.am54.gui - package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.gui
    JavaFX graphical user interface (the "V" in MVC).
    it.polimi.ingsw.am54.gui.managers - package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.gui.managers
    GUI support managers: encapsulate complex portions of the game board (player dashboard, card market, totem animations, and rendering) to lighten the FXML controllers.
    it.polimi.ingsw.am54.gui.states - package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.gui.states
    Client-side management of game phases, shared between the GUI and CLI.
    it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model - package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model
    Game domain model (the "M" in MVC): rules, entities and game state.
    it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.effects.buildings - package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.effects.buildings
    Building Effects.
    it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.effects.characters - package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.effects.characters
    Character Effects (Hunter, Constructor, Shaman and the passive ones: Artist/Inventor/Gatherer).
    it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.effects.events - package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.effects.events
    Global Event Effects (Hunting, Sustenance, Cave Paintings, Shamanic Ritual).
    it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.states - package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.states
    Concrete states of the game's state machine (State Pattern).
    it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.client - package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.client
    Client side of the network and local state.
    it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.messages - package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.messages
    Network messages exchanged between client and server, with polymorphic dispatch.
    it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.rmi - package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.rmi
    RMI remote interfaces.

    SocketClientHandler - Class in it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.server
    ============================================================================ SocketClientHandler — Handler for a TCP connection for a client ============================================================================ ROLE: - Separate thread for each client connected via TCP Socket - Reads Requests from the client and forwards them to the Controller (single game) - Implements ClientConnection (sendUpdate) and ClientHandler - Manages the heartbeat system (ping/pong) to detect disconnections PING-PONG PATTERN: - Ping every 5 seconds (PING_INTERVAL_MS) - If no Pong is received within 15 seconds (PING_TIMEOUT_MS): 1.

    startPingScheduler() - Method in class it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.server.RMIClientHandler

    startPingScheduler() - Method in class it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.server.SocketClientHandler
    Starts the heartbeat: sends a ping every 5000L ms and, if it doesn't receive a pong within 15000L ms, declares the client disconnected.
